scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:distribution
scripts.cloud-events:config: test -f demo/cloud-events/.env && node scripts/render-cloud-event-nats-config.mjs && docker compose --project-name enterprise-aiops-cloud-events --env-file demo/cloud-events/.env -f demo/cloud-events/compose.yaml config -q
scripts.cloud-events:up: npm run cloud-events:config && docker compose --project-name enterprise-aiops-cloud-events --env-file demo/cloud-events/.env -f demo/cloud-events/compose.yaml up -d --build
scripts.cloud-events:down: docker compose --project-name enterprise-aiops-cloud-events --env-file demo/cloud-events/.env -f demo/cloud-events/compose.yaml down
scripts.gitlab:config: test -f demo/gitlab/.env && docker compose --project-name enterprise-aiops-gitlab --env-file demo/gitlab/.env -f demo/gitlab/compose.yaml config -q
scripts.gitlab:up: npm run gitlab:config && docker compose --project-name enterprise-aiops-gitlab --env-file demo/gitlab/.env -f demo/gitlab/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.gitlab:status: docker compose --project-name enterprise-aiops-gitlab --env-file demo/gitlab/.env -f demo/gitlab/compose.yaml ps
scripts.gitlab:down: docker compose --project-name enterprise-aiops-gitlab --env-file demo/gitlab/.env -f demo/gitlab/compose.yaml down
scripts.tofu:validate: docker run --rm -v $PWD:/workspace -w /workspace ghcr.io/opentofu/opentofu@sha256:1cdf44e7a44a67c7838ada83c71ad28b4c4e1571b47ad1c5b592624c2c8f35b5 -chdir=infra/opentofu/local-lab init -backend=false && docker run --rm -v $PWD:/workspace -w /workspace ghcr.io/opentofu/opentofu@sha256:1cdf44e7a44a67c7838ada83c71ad28b4c4e1571b47ad1c5b592624c2c8f35b5 -chdir=infra/opentofu/local-lab validate
scripts.k3s:deploy:cloud-reference: k3s kubectl apply -f k8s/cloud-reference/namespace.yaml && k3s kubectl apply -f k8s/cloud-reference/workload.yaml
scripts.k3s:verify:cloud-reference: k3s kubectl -n cloud-reference rollout status deployment/cloud-reference --timeout=120s
scripts.demo:config: test -f demo/netbox-lab/.env && docker compose --project-name enterprise-mcp-kit-demo --env-file demo/netbox-lab/.env -f demo/netbox-lab/compose.yaml config -q
scripts.demo:up: npm run demo:config && docker compose --project-name enterprise-mcp-kit-demo --env-file demo/netbox-lab/.env -f demo/netbox-lab/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.demo:identity:up: bash demo/netbox-lab/scripts/ensure-keycloak-env.sh && docker compose --project-name enterprise-mcp-kit-demo --env-file demo/netbox-lab/.env -f demo/netbox-lab/compose.yaml up -d keycloak
